params.title: fix(functions): make delivery helpers work first time under pi-action
params.msg:
fix(functions): make delivery helpers work first time under pi-action

- tests.runTargeted, tests.probeMutation, and delivery.format run npx --no-install, so a
  missing install fails instead of fetching an unrelated vitest from the registry
- delivery.commit refuses to push main/master (allowDefaultBranch overrides) and retries a
  transient "(failed)" push rejection once
- ci.waitForRun, ci.waitForCommit, and pr.waitForChecks cap timeoutMs at 285000 instead of
  rejecting larger values

Refs #379
params.body:
Refs #379 (area: project functions in `.pi/functions`).

Fixes the project-helper failures found in the saved pi-action threads:

| Change | Evidence |
|---|---|
| `tests.runTargeted`, `tests.probeMutation`, `delivery.format` call `npx --no-install` | 4 `runTargeted` failures (368, 372 ×2, 375): with no `node_modules`, `npx` fetched **vitest@5.1.0** from the registry and then failed on `vitest/config`. Now a missing install fails directly (and #380 installs dependencies up front). |
| `delivery.commit({ push: true })` refuses `main`/`master` before staging; `allowDefaultBranch: true` overrides | 370#7 and 376#9 committed on protected `main`, push was declined, and the commit had to be moved to a branch by hand. |
| `delivery.commit` retries a `[remote rejected] … (failed)` push once; other rejections report git's stderr | 366#8 failed with `(failed)`; the identical push succeeded right after. It happened again while pushing #380. |
| `ci.waitForRun`, `ci.waitForCommit`, `pr.waitForChecks` cap `timeoutMs` at 285000 instead of throwing | 366#13 and 368#17 were rejected with `timeoutMs must be an integer between 1000 and 285000`. |

Tests: new `delivery.commit` cases (default-branch refusal and override, transient retry, hook rejection without retry) and a `ci.waitForRun` cap case; existing argv expectations are updated for `--no-install`. Targeted function tests (167) and `npm run check` pass.
